The '''Laim system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system was devoid of [[Planet/Legends|planets]], but had a [[Subspace relay station/Legends|subspace relay station]] which was part of the [[Rayter Sector Subspace Broadcast Network]]. It was four hours' hyperspace travel from the [[Najarka system/Legends|Najarka system]] and six hours' travel from the [[Narg system/Legends|Narg system]] with a standard [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].
